MINT AI

The app's own settings, on this computer. MINT AI's settings (voice, approvals, sessions) are on the site, in MINT AI ▸ Settings.

Where it lives

ModeFloating sits in a corner above every window; Peek stays hidden until you call it; Desktop layer lives on the wallpaper, under every window; Companion steps out of the box and lives on your desk.
Focus modeJust the core; its colour and motion still say what it is doing.
Glance cardsBeside MINT AI: approvals waiting, sessions, today's tokens and live alerts. On the desktop you can drag them anywhere and pin them there (remembered per monitor). Focus mode hides them.
MonitorPeek always opens where the mouse is.

Companion

The bot out of its box: it sits on the taskbar or on the top edge of the window you are using, walks over when you switch windows or monitors, steps aside when the mouse comes near (rest the mouse on it to click it), and ducks out of full-screen video, games and meetings. Click it for the Command Center. The tray switches it on and off.

Where it sits
Session botsSessions waiting on you gather beside it, and wander off when they are back at work.
Stay on this monitorOff: it follows the window you are using to the other monitor.

Eye contact

Use this computer's camera so MINT AI knows when you are there. Off unless you switch it on. The bot looks at you and follows you as you move, looks up when you sit down and dozes when you walk away; the glance cards come forward while you look at the screen; toasts and sounds wait while you are away and come as one summary when you are back.

Everything happens on this computer: a small face model in MINT AI's page reads a small picture a few times a second and throws it away. No picture, video or face data is stored or sent anywhere — not to Mint OS, not to anyone; only "here / looking / away" is used. The camera light is on while it works. It lets go of the camera when you switch this off (here, or the tray's "Camera presence"), when MINT AI is hidden, the screen locks, or another app is in a meeting. Only this window and the tray can switch it on.

Camera presence
Look and speakFace MINT AI and start talking: it listens without the talk key. While you face it, a microphone level meter runs (nothing is recorded or sent until you speak). A reply pauses when you look away and goes on when you look back.
Let go of the camera in energy saverOn battery it looks less often (2 times a second instead of 5).

Hotkeys

Click a box, then press the keys. Ctrl or Alt plus one key. Esc (hide Peek, end a call) works while MINT AI has the focus.

Talk (hold)
Live conversation (start / end)
Show / hide
Focus mode

Ctrl+Space is "trigger suggestion" in VS Code and switches the input method on Chinese and Japanese keyboards; MINT AI takes it from every app while it runs. Ctrl+Alt+Space is the alternative.

Behaviour

Do not disturbNo Windows toasts; the amber tray dot stays.
Battery saverOn battery, with Windows' energy saver, or while a full-screen app runs, the core holds still.
Real blur behind cardsThe chat panel, the state pill and the cards frost what is behind them (Windows 10 version 1809 or later, Windows 11). Off: tinted, as before. Approval cards stay near-solid either way.

Experimental

Desktop layer behind the iconsUses undocumented Windows behaviour (live wallpapers use it; Windows updates have broken it). Behind the icons MINT AI cannot be clicked at all: talk with the hotkey, and use Ctrl+Alt+M to bring it up.
